name: SDN HTTP Respond
description: Single-purpose flow node: assembles one $HTR HttpResponse envelope from a routing-decision JSON frame (foundation/http-route contract) plus optional body / etag / error frames. Behavior: an "error" input (JSON {"error":msg}) wins over everything -> 502 application/json {"error":msg}; decision route=not_found -> 404 application/json {"error":decision.error|"not found"}; an "etag" input equal to decision.ifNoneMatch -> 304 with an etag header and empty body; otherwise 200 with the body frame verbatim (empty body when the frame is absent), content-type from decision.format (flatbuffer -> application/vnd.sdn.flatbuffers.stream, json -> application/json), x-sdn-record-count when derivable (the count of size-prefixed frames when format=flatbuffer and the body framing parses cleanly), and an etag header whenever the etag input is present. All response headers are lower-cased and sorted per the $HTR ABI. Pure compute — no capabilities.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Routing-decision UTF-8 JSON bytes from foundation/http-route (aligned-binary wire format): {"route","format","ifNoneMatch"?,"error"?,...}.

inputPorts.description: Routing decision controlling status, content-type, and conditional-request handling.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Response body bytes passed through verbatim: an ALIGNED size-prefixed FlatBuffer stream (decision.format=flatbuffer) or JSON bytes (decision.format=json).

inputPorts.description: Optional response body frame; absent means an empty 200 body.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Entity tag as raw UTF-8 string bytes. Compared verbatim against decision.ifNoneMatch for 304 handling and echoed as the etag response header.
Upstream error as UTF-8 JSON bytes {"error":"message"} (plain text tolerated). Presence forces a 502 response.
Canonical WASM-served HTTP response envelope ($HTR, module-sdk schemas/HttpResponseAbi.fbs): STATUS, HEADERS (sorted, lower-cased names), BODY. The host streams it back verbatim.

outputPorts.description: Exactly one HTTP response envelope per invoke.

methods.description: Builds the $HTR response: 502 on upstream error, 404 on not_found, 304 on ETag match, else 200 with negotiated content-type, optional x-sdn-record-count, and optional etag header.
